candidates.title: Hello everyone! Join us for our blood glucose talk on Wednesday 21 Oct!

caption.text:
Hello everyone! Join us for our blood glucose talk on Wednesday 21 Oct!

Wed 21 Oct · 7-8:30pm · ER143

It's a 20-minute talk learning about the impact of foods on our entire biology: how the foods we eat affect our blood glucose and, in turn, our health and experience of life, with an impact on our bodies now and in the long term, and what you can do about it. Including understanding why we get tired after lunch, crave sweet things, feel hungry again so soon, struggle to focus and struggle to lose weight, and how we can super easily improve it.

There'll be time to chat and ask questions afterwards, as we're all learning together! It's for everyone and no science background is needed. It's general information, not medical advice.

Hope to see you there ❤️

caption.text:
🌟Join the AW26 cohort of DAISI's Foundations of AI Safety Fellowship, starting at 18:30 BST on Thursday 15th October (subject to change due to fellow availability).🌟

This is a chance to build a strong foundation in AI safety, get involved in Durham’s community, and eat free Rudy's pizza with lots of like-minded people!

We're running a free 8-week programme to help students develop their big-picture understanding of AI safety and AGI.

The fellowship consists of a 90-minute session each week between 18:30 and 20:00, where you will meet with a group and a facilitator to read, discuss, and debate how advanced AI develops, the pathways to harm, and the narrative portrayed in the media. You'll be placed in a group of applicants with similar AI safety experience and interests to ensure your engagement with the content. The curriculum covers foundational arguments in AI safety and helps you build a strong basis for your future decisions in the field. 

Apply now through the link in our bio! The deadline for applications is Friday 9th October.
